// diagnostic

E2812

`{remote}` has no endpoint `{method}`: the method is server-only.

What

`{remote}` has no endpoint `{method}`: the method is server-only.

Why

A client reaches a service only through the methods marked `#App.SignedIn` or `#App.Public`; an unmarked method, a job, a webhook or a signing key stays on the server.

Fix

Mark `{method}` `#App.SignedIn` for signed-in callers or `#App.Public` for any caller, or call it from server code that holds the service.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2812: tests/ui/web_app_remote_server_only_method.stderr.

Error [jet.ServerOnlyMethod]: `app.Remote<Crew>` has no endpoint `secret`: the method is server-only.
  --> tests/ui/web_app_remote_server_only_method.jet:12:13
    |
 12 |     _: crew.secret()
    |             ^^^^^^
 Why: A client reaches a service only through the methods marked `#App.SignedIn` or `#App.Public`; an unmarked method, a job, a webhook or a signing key stays on the server.
 Fix: Mark `secret` `#App.SignedIn` for signed-in callers or `#App.Public` for any caller, or call it from server code that holds the service.
